description: This file defines a CultureInfo object for Serbian (Cyrillic) language in Bosnia and Herzegovina, including localized date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and date manipulation functions specific to this culture.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time portion of a Date object to midnight (00:00:00.000).

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on day name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on month name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name based on its offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
